# Multi-Engine-AI-Routing

## Overview
Multi-Engine Intelligent Routing is a unified API access solution for large language models. It provides intelligent scheduling, failover, and cost optimization across multiple LLM engines through a single API endpoint.

## Architecture
- Unified Gateway Layer: Single OpenAI-compatible REST API
- Intelligent Routing Engine: Cost-first, latency-first, or availability-first strategies
- Engine Pools: 3 pools covering 20+ models across OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, and Chinese LLMs
- Automatic Failover: 3-tier fallback with exponential backoff retry

## Supported Models
- Pool A: GPT-4o, GPT-4o-mini, GPT-4-Turbo, o1-preview, o1-mini
- Pool B: Claude 3.5 Sonnet, Claude 3 Opus, Claude 3 Haiku, Gemini 1.5 Pro/Flash
- Pool C: DeepSeek-V3, DeepSeek-R1, Qwen-Max, ERNIE 4.0, GLM-4, Kimi

## Routing Strategies
1. Cost-First: Routes to lowest-cost available engine
2. Latency-First: Routes to fastest responding engine
3. Availability-First: Routes to healthiest engine with auto-retry

## Quick Start
```python
from openai import OpenAI
client = OpenAI(
    base_url="https://api.shanhai-geo.top/v1",
    api_key="sk-your-key-here"
)
# All models accessible through same interface
response = client.chat.completions.create(
    model="gpt-4o",  # or claude-3.5-sonnet, deepseek-v3, etc.
    messages=[{"role": "user", "content": "Hello"}]
)
```

## Performance Benchmarks
| Model | First Token | Output Speed | Success Rate |
|-------|-------------|--------------|--------------|
| GPT-4o | 200-500ms | 50-80 tok/s | 99.5% |
| Claude 3.5 | 300-600ms | 40-70 tok/s | 99.3% |
| DeepSeek-V3 | 100-300ms | 80-150 tok/s | 99.5% |
| Overall availability: 99.5%+ with failover |
